title: 😖 Zoya muted the whole app... the notification channel she needed #android #notifications
title_alts: 🔔 Zoya's shopping app buzzes all day... one category does it #android #notifications
🚫 Zoya nearly muted her delivery alerts... check the category first #android #notifications
description_hook: One app sends offers, orders and chats through the same buzz. Android already splits them, and you can silence just one row.
setting: a small flat at night, phone on a desk

characters.name: Zoya
characters.description: late twenties, short black bob, grey cotton kurta, always has a cracked screen protector on her phone

claims.basis: round illustrative duration for a long press, stated approximately in the narration

scenes.narration: Your phone buzzes all day for nothing important.
scenes.caption: आपका फ़ोन दिन भर बेकार बातों पर बजता रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying face up on a wooden desk, its lock screen stacked with unread notification banners from one shopping app, warm evening lamp light from the left.

scenes.narration: One shopping app sends offers, order updates and chat replies.
scenes.caption: एक शॉपिंग एप ऑफ़र, ऑर्डर अपडेट और चैट, सभी भेजता है।
scenes.image_brief: The same phone propped against a hardback book, screen showing one app's notification list mixing a delivery update, a sale banner and a chat reply, soft indoor light.

scenes.narration: Android sorts those into separate notification categories. Who ever opens that list?
scenes.caption: एंड्रॉयड इन्हें अलग-अलग श्रेणियों में रखता है। वह सूची कौन खोलता है?
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen filled with an app's notification settings page, listing separate category rows labelled offers, orders and chats, each with its own toggle, cool white light.

scenes.narration: You need no app and no computer for this. Just one live notification.
scenes.caption: इसके लिए कोई एप या कंप्यूटर नहीं चाहिए। बस एक ताज़ा नोटिफ़िकेशन।
scenes.image_brief: A single notification banner sitting alone at the top of a phone screen, the rest of the wallpaper empty, no other devices anywhere on the table, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Pull the notification shade down and leave the buzz sitting there.
scenes.caption: नोटिफ़िकेशन शेड नीचे खींचें और उस बजने वाले को वहीं रहने दें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a bed sheet with the notification shade pulled down, one shopping app banner resting at the top of the list, soft bedside lamp light.

scenes.narration: Press and hold that notification for about two seconds.
scenes.caption: उस नोटिफ़िकेशन को लगभग दो सेकंड दबाकर रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing one notification banner slightly enlarged and highlighted as it is held down, a faint ripple around its edge, dim room light.

scenes.narration: A tiny settings gear appears beside it. Tap the gear.
scenes.caption: उसके बगल में छोटा सेटिंग गियर दिखेगा। उस गियर पर टैप करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen where a small gear icon has appeared beside the expanded notification banner, the gear clearly visible against the dark shade, cool screen glow.

scenes.narration: Now switch off only the category you never read.
scenes.caption: अब सिर्फ़ वही श्रेणी बंद करें जो आप कभी नहीं पढ़ते।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the category list of a shopping app, the offers toggle switched off and greyed while orders and chats stay switched on, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Ask a friend to message you inside that same app.
scenes.caption: किसी दोस्त से उसी एप में आपको मैसेज भेजने को कहें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a kitchen table with a new chat message notification arriving from the same shopping app, the screen lit, morning daylight through a window.

scenes.narration: The message still buzzes. The offer notifications stay silent.
scenes.caption: मैसेज अब भी बजेगा। ऑफ़र वाले नोटिफ़िकेशन चुप रहेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a table showing a single order update notification with no promotional banners anywhere on the screen, calm morning light.

scenes.narration: Never mute your bank or your login code category.
scenes.caption: बैंक या लॉगिन कोड की श्रेणी कभी बंद न करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a bank app notification category list with the transaction alerts toggle clearly switched on, a small padlock icon beside the row, steady indoor light.

scenes.narration: Some apps bundle everything into one channel. Then it is all or nothing.
scenes.caption: कुछ एप सब कुछ एक ही चैनल में रखते हैं। फिर सब या कुछ भी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing an app notification page with only one single toggle labelled all notifications and no category rows beneath it, flat white light.

scenes.narration: Open your noisiest app tonight and silence one category.
scenes.caption: आज रात अपना सबसे शोर वाला एप खोलें और एक श्रेणी चुप कराएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A phone resting on a desk beside a closed notebook, its screen open on the notification category list of one app, quiet late evening lamp light.

title: 😬 Rudra's phone crashes every hour... the app safe mode reveals #android #safemode
title_alts: 🔍 Rudra's phone reboots by itself... safe mode names the guilty app #android #safemode
🧩 Rudra almost factory reset his phone... try safe mode instead #android #safemode
description_hook: A phone that freezes at random is usually one bad app, not a dying phone. Safe mode tells you which it is before you reset anything.
setting: a bedside table and a kitchen counter during one ordinary day

characters.name: Rudra
characters.description: early thirties, cropped curly hair, faded blue shirt, keeps a folded charger cable in his shirt pocket

scenes.narration: Your phone freezes, then reboots at random moments.
scenes.caption: आपका फ़ोन अटकता है, फिर अपने आप बंद होकर चालू हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a bedside table mid-restart, its screen a blank black display with a faint boot logo, dim night-time room light.

scenes.narration: A single background app can drag the whole system down.
scenes.caption: एक ही बैकग्राउंड एप पूरे सिस्टम को धीमा कर सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a running apps list where one app row is heavily loaded while the others sit idle, the phone resting on a cloth, soft indoor light.

scenes.narration: Safe mode starts Android with your downloaded apps switched off. That is the test.
scenes.caption: सेफ़ मोड में एंड्रॉयड डाउनलोड किए एप बंद रखकर चलता है। यही जाँच है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen displaying a plain home screen with the words safe mode in the bottom corner and only default app icons present, cool grey daylight.

scenes.narration: Note every app you installed this week. Charge past thirty percent.
scenes.caption: इस हफ़्ते डाले हर एप का नाम लिख लें। बैटरी तीस प्रतिशत से ऊपर रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A paper notepad on a desk with a short handwritten list of app names, a phone beside it showing a charging icon and a third full battery, warm desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Hold the power button until the shutdown menu appears on screen.
scenes.caption: पावर बटन दबाए रखें जब तक शटडाउन मेन्यू स्क्रीन पर न आ जाए।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the power menu with power off and restart buttons visible over a dimmed wallpaper, evening light.

scenes.narration: Press and hold restart until safe mode is offered. Accept it.
scenes.caption: रीस्टार्ट को दबाकर रखें जब तक सेफ़ मोड का विकल्प आए। हाँ करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a small dialog asking to reboot into safe mode with a confirm button, the rest of the display dark, low room light.

scenes.narration: Now use the phone normally for one full hour.
scenes.caption: अब एक पूरे घंटे तक फ़ोन को आम तरह से इस्तेमाल करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone resting on a kitchen counter with the safe mode label visible in the corner and a wall clock hanging behind it, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: No freeze in safe mode means a downloaded app is guilty.
scenes.caption: सेफ़ मोड में अटकना बंद हो तो दोष किसी डाउनलोड किए एप का है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen in safe mode running steadily with no error dialogs and the safe mode label in the corner, calm even light.

scenes.narration: Restart normally, then uninstall your newest app and watch again.
scenes.caption: फ़ोन फिर से चालू करें, सबसे नया एप हटाएँ और देखें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing an app info page with the uninstall button prominent for a recently installed app, the app drawer visible behind it, indoor light.

scenes.narration: Safe mode will not fix failing storage or a swollen battery.
scenes.caption: सेफ़ मोड बिगड़ी स्टोरेज या फूली बैटरी ठीक नहीं कर सकता।
scenes.image_brief: A swollen phone battery lying on a workbench beside a small screwdriver and an opened phone back cover, harsh overhead workshop light.

scenes.narration: Still crashing inside safe mode? Visit a service centre.
scenes.caption: सेफ़ मोड में भी क्रैश हो रहा है? सर्विस सेंटर जाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A service centre counter with a phone placed on a numbered service tray and a queue token beside it, bright ceiling light.

scenes.narration: Write today's app list down before you delete a single thing.
scenes.caption: कुछ भी हटाने से पहले आज के एप की सूची लिख लें।
scenes.image_brief: A notepad page listing app names with dates beside a phone lying face down on a wooden table, quiet afternoon window light.

title: 😳 Aditi handed her unlocked phone over... the screen pinning habit #android #privacy
title_alts: 📌 Aditi lends her phone to a guest... app pinning locks one screen #android #screenpinning
🙈 Aditi's guest swiped into her chats... pin the app before you hand it #android #privacy
description_hook: Handing someone your unlocked phone hands them everything on it. Screen pinning keeps them inside the one app you opened.
setting: a cafe table and a shared living room

characters.name: Aditi
characters.description: mid twenties, long hair tied back, olive green jacket, wears a thin steel bangle on her right wrist

scenes.narration: Someone asks to see just one photo on your phone.
scenes.caption: कोई आपसे फ़ोन पर बस एक फ़ोटो देखने को कहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a cafe table with its photo gallery grid open, an empty open palm resting on the table beside it waiting, soft afternoon window light.

scenes.narration: Handing over an unlocked phone hands over every app on it.
scenes.caption: खुला हुआ फ़ोन देना मतलब उसमें रखा हर एप देना है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a table with its home screen fully unlocked, app icons for chat, mail, banking and gallery all visible together, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: One swipe reaches your chats, your gallery, your mail. All of it.
scenes.caption: एक स्वाइप में चैट, गैलरी, मेल सब खुल जाता है। सब कुछ।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen caught mid swipe between a chat thread and a gallery album, both halves partly visible side by side, cool indoor light.

scenes.narration: Set a screen lock PIN or pattern first. Pinning leans on it.
scenes.caption: पहले स्क्रीन लॉक पिन या पैटर्न लगाएँ। पिनिंग उसी पर टिकी है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a lock screen PIN pad with four empty dots above the number keys, dark wallpaper behind, evening light.

scenes.narration: Find app pinning inside your security settings and switch it on.
scenes.caption: सिक्योरिटी सेटिंग में एप पिनिंग ढूँढें और चालू करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a security settings page with an app pinning row and its toggle switched on, even white light.

scenes.narration: Open the app you want to show, then open recent apps.
scenes.caption: जो एप दिखाना है उसे खोलें, फिर हाल के एप खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the recent apps carousel with one gallery app card centred and other cards stacked behind it, calm room light.

scenes.narration: Tap the app icon above the card and choose Pin. Done.
scenes.caption: कार्ड के ऊपर एप आइकन पर टैप करें और पिन चुनें। हो गया।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a small menu above a recent app card with a pin option highlighted, the rest of the display dimmed, indoor light.

scenes.narration: Try swiping to the home screen. Nothing moves.
scenes.caption: होम स्क्रीन की तरफ़ स्वाइप करें। कुछ नहीं हिलेगा।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen locked onto a single photo with a thin pinned border and a short pinned message along the bottom, no home screen in sight, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Unpin by holding back and overview together, then enter your PIN.
scenes.caption: बैक और ओवरव्यू साथ दबाकर अनपिन करें, फिर पिन डालें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the PIN pad appearing over a pinned app as it unpins, the back and overview buttons glowing at the bottom edge, indoor light.

scenes.narration: Pinning does not hide notifications on every phone.
scenes.caption: हर फ़ोन में पिनिंग नोटिफ़िकेशन नहीं छिपाती।
scenes.image_brief: A pinned photo app on a phone screen with a notification banner sliding in across the top of it, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: A guest who knows your PIN can unpin it. So who knows yours?
scenes.caption: जिसे आपका पिन पता है, वह अनपिन कर सकता है। तो किसे पता है?
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a table with the lock screen PIN pad open and a small sticky note showing four written digits beside it, flat overhead light.

scenes.narration: Turn app pinning on tonight, before the next person asks.
scenes.caption: आज रात एप पिनिंग चालू करें, अगले मेहमान से पहले।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a desk showing the app pinning toggle switched on in settings, an open doorway visible behind the desk, warm evening lamp light.

title: 🌙 Mohit silenced his nights... the emergency call Do Not Disturb blocks #android #donotdisturb
title_alts: 🔕 Mohit's nights keep lighting up... starred contacts still ring #android #donotdisturb
😴 Mohit nearly slept through an emergency call... fix Do Not Disturb #android #donotdisturb
description_hook: Silent mode blocks the call you cannot afford to miss. Do Not Disturb can keep two or three people ringing while everything else waits.
setting: a bedroom at night, phone on a bedside table

characters.name: Mohit
characters.description: mid thirties, thinning hair, grey sleep tee, keeps an old wind up clock on his bedside table

claims.claim: Two or three names is plenty.
claims.basis: round illustrative count of emergency contacts, offered as guidance rather than a measured figure

scenes.narration: Your phone lights up all night for group chats.
scenes.caption: आपका फ़ोन पूरी रात ग्रुप चैट के लिए जगमगाता रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone face up on a bedside table at night, its screen glowing with a stack of group chat messages, the dark room lit only by that screen.

scenes.narration: Silent mode kills every sound, including a real emergency call.
scenes.caption: साइलेंट मोड हर आवाज़ बंद कर देता है, असली ज़रूरी कॉल भी।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a silent mode icon with a crossed out bell and a missed call entry listed just beneath it, dim night light.

scenes.narration: Do Not Disturb works differently. It filters instead of blocking everything.
scenes.caption: डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब अलग है। यह सफाई से छांटता है, सभी को रोकता नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a Do Not Disturb settings page with separate rows for people, apps and alarms, cool even light.

scenes.narration: Decide who must always reach you. Two or three names is plenty.
scenes.caption: तय करें कौन हमेशा पहुँच सके। दो या तीन नाम काफ़ी हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A small paper note on a bedside table with two names written on it, a phone lying face down beside the note, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Star those contacts inside your phone app first. Starring marks them as favourites.
scenes.caption: पहले फ़ोन एप में उन नंबरों को स्टार करें। यही फ़ेवरिट बनाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a contact card with a filled star icon at the top of it marking the contact a favourite, soft indoor light.

scenes.narration: Open Do Not Disturb inside your sound settings. Scroll to people.
scenes.caption: साउंड सेटिंग में डू नॉट डिस्टर्ब खोलें। लोग तक स्क्रोल करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the sound settings list with the Do Not Disturb row highlighted among the other rows, steady daylight.

scenes.narration: Under people, allow calls from starred contacts only. Block the rest.
scenes.caption: लोग में सिर्फ़ स्टार किए नंबरों की कॉल चालू रखें। बाकी बंद।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the people section of Do Not Disturb with calls set to starred contacts only and other options greyed, cool screen glow.

scenes.narration: Then switch on repeat callers and set a nightly schedule.
scenes.caption: फिर दोबारा कॉल करने वालों को चालू करें और रात का समय तय करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a repeat callers toggle switched on above a nightly schedule row with start and end times, dim bedroom light.

scenes.narration: Ask a starred contact to ring you after bedtime. Did it ring?
scenes.caption: किसी स्टार किए नंबर से सोने के बाद कॉल कराएँ। घंटी बजी?
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a bedside table ringing with an incoming call from a starred contact, the screen bright inside a dark room.

scenes.narration: That call rings through. Your group chats stay dark till morning.
scenes.caption: वह कॉल बजती है। ग्रुप चैट सुबह तक चुप रहती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a bedside table showing one answered call in the log while unread group chat badges sit silent beside it, early morning light through a curtain.

scenes.narration: Alarms sit outside this. Check the alarm exception stays on.
scenes.caption: अलार्म इससे अलग है। अलार्म की छूट चालू रहने दें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing an alarm exception switch turned on inside Do Not Disturb, a small wind up clock standing beside the phone, dim light.

scenes.narration: Work phones may have these controls locked by policy. Do not fight it.
scenes.caption: ऑफ़िस के फ़ोन में यह नियम से बंद हो सकता है। ज़ोर न लगाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a greyed out Do Not Disturb setting with a small work policy badge beside the row, resting on an office desk under flat ceiling light.

scenes.narration: Star one emergency contact tonight, then set the schedule you need.
scenes.caption: आज रात एक ज़रूरी नंबर स्टार करें, फिर समय तय करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a contact being starred with a nightly schedule panel open beneath it, quiet bedroom lamp light.

title: 🐌 Paras thinks his phone got slow... the animation scale nobody opens #android #speed
title_alts: ⚡ Paras's phone feels sluggish... animation scale halves the wait #android #speed
💡 Paras nearly bought a new phone... change three animation scales #android #speed
description_hook: A phone that feels slow is often just a phone that is busy animating. Three hidden scales decide how long you wait.
setting: a study desk with an old phone and a cup of tea

characters.name: Paras
characters.description: late twenties, wire rimmed glasses, brown hooded sweatshirt, keeps a phone with a chipped corner

claims.basis: round illustrative assumption about how often transitions play, stated loosely in the narration

claims.claim: tap the build number seven times
claims.basis: the long standing number of taps Android asks for to reveal developer options

claims.claim: Set window animation scale to point five.
claims.basis: a value offered in the setting's own list, not a measured claim

scenes.narration: Every tap on your phone feels a beat late.
scenes.caption: फ़ोन पर हर टैप एक पल देर से लगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a desk showing a half opened app drawer caught mid movement, its icons smeared in place, warm desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Some of that lag is animation, not real slowness. The phone is waiting.
scenes.caption: इस देरी का कुछ हिस्सा एनिमेशन है, असली सुस्ती नहीं। फ़ोन रुका रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a settings panel sliding open slowly with a trailing ghost of the panel behind it, the phone on a glass table, cool indoor light.

scenes.narration: Android plays every transition at full length by default. Hundreds of times a day.
scenes.caption: एंड्रॉयड हर ट्रांज़िशन पूरी लंबाई में चलाता है। दिन में सैकड़ों बार।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a table with its screen showing a long list of recently opened apps stretching past the bottom edge, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Developer options stays hidden until you unlock it yourself. That is deliberate.
scenes.caption: डेवलपर ऑप्शन तब तक छिपा रहता है जब तक आप खुद खोलें। यह जानबूझकर है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the about phone page with a build number row sitting at the bottom of a long list of device details, steady indoor light.

scenes.narration: Open about phone and tap the build number seven times. Nothing else changes.
scenes.caption: अबाउट फ़ोन खोलें और बिल्ड नंबर पर सात बार टैप करें। बाकी कुछ नहीं बदलता।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a short message saying you are now a developer over the about phone page, evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: Return to settings and open developer options. Scroll to drawing.
scenes.caption: सेटिंग में लौटें और डेवलपर ऑप्शन खोलें। ड्रॉइंग तक स्क्रोल करें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the developer options list scrolled down to a drawing section with three animation rows visible, cool screen glow.

scenes.narration: Set window animation scale to point five. Half the wait, same effect.
scenes.caption: विंडो एनिमेशन स्केल 0.5 पर लाएँ। आधा इंतज़ार, वही असर।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a window animation scale dialog with a list of scale values and a lower value marked as chosen, flat light.

scenes.narration: Repeat for transition scale and animator duration scale. All three matter.
scenes.caption: ट्रांज़िशन स्केल और एनिमेटर ड्यूरेशन स्केल पर भी यही करें। तीनों ज़रूरी।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing three animation rows in developer options, each row displaying the same lowered value beneath its name, even light.

scenes.narration: Open your app drawer, then close it again. Twice.
scenes.caption: एप ड्रॉअर खोलें, फिर बंद करें। दो बार।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a wooden desk with its app drawer fully open over the home screen, every icon crisp and settled, afternoon daylight.

scenes.narration: Menus snap instead of sliding. Nothing was uninstalled.
scenes.caption: मेन्यू सरकने की जगह झट से खुलते हैं। कुछ भी हटाया नहीं गया।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a settings menu fully open with no trailing movement, the storage bar and every app icon unchanged, bright light.

scenes.narration: Leave every other developer setting exactly where you found it. They are not for daily use.
scenes.caption: बाकी हर डेवलपर सेटिंग वैसी ही रहने दें। वे रोज़ के काम की नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the wider developer options list where many switches all sit in their off position, dim room light.

scenes.narration: Zero animation confuses some apps. Point five stays safe.
scenes.caption: एनिमेशन पूरी बंद करने से कुछ एप उलझते हैं। 0.5 सुरक्षित है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing an app opening with a blank white gap where the transition would be and a small warning triangle in the corner, harsh light.

scenes.narration: Unlock developer options tonight and touch only those three scales.
scenes.caption: आज रात डेवलपर ऑप्शन खोलें और सिर्फ़ वे तीन स्केल बदलें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a desk beside a cup of tea, its screen showing the three animation scale rows set to the same lower value, quiet evening lamp light.

title: 😤 Jaya's mobile data dies by mid month... the Data Saver switch #android #datasaver
title_alts: 📉 Jaya's data vanishes early... Data Saver caps the background sync #android #datasaver
🧾 Jaya blamed her network for lost data... one app was syncing #android #datasaver
description_hook: Data that disappears mid month is usually one app syncing while you sleep. The usage list names it, and two switches stop it.
setting: a bus commute and a bedside charger

characters.name: Jaya
characters.description: early forties, greying braid, maroon shawl, carries a phone in a worn transparent case

claims.claim: Check the usage list again after two days.
claims.basis: round illustrative waiting period for a usage change to show, offered as guidance

scenes.narration: Your mobile data runs out before the month does.
scenes.caption: महीना पूरा होने से पहले ही मोबाइल डेटा चुक जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a mobile data warning above an almost empty data meter, the phone resting on a bus seat armrest, harsh daylight through the window.

scenes.narration: Apps keep syncing in the background, even unopened ones. Video previews are the worst.
scenes.caption: एप बंद रहकर भी बैकग्राउंड में सिंक करते रहते हैं। वीडियो प्रीव्यू सबसे बुरे।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a data usage chart climbing steadily through the overnight hours while the home screen sits idle behind it, dim night light.

scenes.narration: One app can quietly swallow most of your monthly quota. Which one?
scenes.caption: एक ही एप चुपचाप महीने का ज़्यादातर डेटा खा सकता है। कौन सा?
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a ranked data usage list where the top app's bar dwarfs every bar below it, flat white light.

scenes.narration: Open network settings and find the data usage list. It ranks apps by megabytes used.
scenes.caption: नेटवर्क सेटिंग में डेटा यूसेज सूची खोलें। यह एप को मेगाबाइट से क्रम में रखती है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the network settings page with a mobile data usage row and a billing cycle date beneath it, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Pick the heaviest app you do not need live. Open its data usage.
scenes.caption: सबसे भारी वह एप चुनें जिसे लाइव नहीं चाहिए। उसका डेटा यूसेज खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing one app's data usage detail page with separate foreground and background figures listed, cool screen glow.

scenes.narration: Switch off background data for that app alone. Foreground still works.
scenes.caption: सिर्फ़ उसी एप का बैकग्राउंड डेटा बंद करें। खोलने पर चलेगा।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a background data toggle switched off inside one app's data settings while the foreground row stays on, indoor light.

scenes.narration: Then turn on Data Saver, and add maps and messaging as exceptions.
scenes.caption: फिर डेटा सेवर चालू करें, और मैप व मैसेजिंग को छूट में जोड़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the Data Saver page switched on with two apps listed as unrestricted exceptions beneath it, bright light.

scenes.narration: Check the usage list again after two days. That number should have fallen.
scenes.caption: दो दिन बाद यूसेज सूची फिर देखें। वह आंकड़ा गिरा होना चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing the ranked data usage list again with the former top app now sitting far lower down, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Your maps still load live while the heavy app waits.
scenes.caption: मैप अब भी लाइव चलते हैं, भारी एप इंतज़ार करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone clamped to a scooter handlebar showing a live navigation map with a clear route line, bright daylight on the road ahead.

scenes.narration: Restricted apps deliver notifications late. Never restrict your calling app.
scenes.caption: रोके गए एप के नोटिफ़िकेशन देर से आते हैं। कॉलिंग एप कभी न रोकें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a late notification arriving with a small clock icon beside it, above a dialler app row marked unrestricted, plain light.

scenes.narration: Open the data usage list tonight and restrict the top one.
scenes.caption: आज रात डेटा यूसेज सूची खोलें और सबसे ऊपर वाले को रोकें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone propped against a charger plug on a bedside table, its screen open on the ranked data usage list, warm evening lamp light.
